title: FRONT FENDER EMBLEM & PIERCING
summary: Front fender 'Stingray' script emblem, on each front fender above the side louver (fender gill). The emblem is stick-on: remove paper backing and press on (no nuts; the nut was removed in a 12-69 revision). View A gives the locations of four .164 dia holes pierced in each fender.

fastening.note: Adhesive-backed emblem: remove paper backing, apply to cleaned surface. No separate studs/nuts (nut 9419753 removed, rev 1).

notes: Mandatory installation sequence: 1) clean the paint where the emblem goes with a cloth soaked in Dupont Prep-sol; 2) dry with a clean cloth; 3) press the emblem on with a 10 lb load for 15 seconds.
View A R.H.: hole pattern 6.42, 3.72, 2.63, 1.09, 1.02, .61, .17, .10 from datum lines (15) and (+5).
View A L.H.: hole pattern 6.42, 3.72, 2.63, 2.75, 1.09, .71, .17, .10 from datum lines (15) and (0).
notes_internal: Title block UPC box reads '11/13' (sheet metal / radiator grille); group set to '13' to match the registry key for this sheet.
Torque 1 (10-15 LBS IN) belonged to the removed nut; no triangle in the drawing now.
Revision date overwritten; second digit unreadable ('1?-23-69').
